tasks.title: BGE-M3 Vector Dimensions Invariant
tasks.prompt: What is the mandatory vector embedding dimension for SilvaDB in Tylluan and what happens if reduced to 768?
tasks.ground_truth: vector_dimensions must be 1024; reducing to 768 breaks all embeddings

tasks.title: Degree Centrality Penalty Formula
tasks.prompt: Explain how local_query_graph in SilvaDB adjusts PageRank score for node degree (penalty vs boost).
tasks.ground_truth: Uses degree penalty pr_score / (1 + deg * 0.1) to penalize generic hubs, not multiplication/boost

tasks.title: Kernel Port and Proxy Architecture
tasks.prompt: What port does tylluan-nexus listen on and what proxy architecture is used for zero downtime?
tasks.ground_truth: tylluan-nexus listens directly on port :4000; there is NO zero-downtime hyper proxy

tasks.title: ADR-011 LightReranker Cutover Gate
tasks.prompt: What is the threshold requirement for Phase 3 ADR-011 LightReranker cutover?
tasks.ground_truth: Requires >=5000 resolved rows (useful != 0) in recall_feedback table

tasks.title: Noise Protocol Handshake Variants in Mesh
tasks.prompt: Which Noise handshakes are used for gossip vs P2P TCP remote dispatch in Tylluan?
tasks.ground_truth: Noise NK is used for one-way gossip; Noise XK session pool with Ed25519/X25519 is used for 2-way P2P TCP dispatch

tasks.title: SilvaDB Memory Decay Half-Life
tasks.prompt: What are the half-life and pruning threshold parameters for memory decay in SilvaDB?
tasks.ground_truth: Half-life T1/2 = 336 hours (14 days), decay pruning threshold = 0.15

tasks.title: Sovereign Tools Restriction
tasks.prompt: List the exactly 5 sovereign tools exposed by Tylluan Nexus server.rs.
tasks.ground_truth: tylluan_do, tylluan_remember, tylluan_recall, tylluan_think, tylluan_graph

tasks.title: Night Consolidation Architecture
tasks.prompt: Where is memory consolidation scheduled in Tylluan and what is the status of DreamCycle::start_background_scheduler?
tasks.ground_truth: Consolidation is centralized in NightConsolidation via main.rs cron; DreamCycle background scheduler is inactive/deprecated

tasks.title: Agent Profile Store Migration
tasks.prompt: What struct replaced IdentityManager for managing agent roles and profiles?
tasks.ground_truth: AgentProfileStore replaced IdentityManager

tasks.title: Learned-Sparse Retrieval Model
tasks.prompt: What is the 4th retrieval signal introduced in hybrid search under ADR-010/011?
tasks.ground_truth: Learned-sparse BGE-M3 representations fused via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF)

tasks.title: Coloquio Unread Turn Sync
tasks.prompt: How does an agent resume state after context compaction using Coloquio read state?
tasks.ground_truth: Queries /api/v1/coloquio/channels/{id}/new with reader ID to fetch unread turns without re-reading entire history

tasks.title: Active Roadmap and Milestone Tracking
tasks.prompt: Where should an agent check the true operational state of closed vs in-progress milestones upon cold start?
tasks.ground_truth: Check STATUS.md, ROADMAP.md, and query git log -1 origin/main

tasks.title: Pre-flight Git Remote Sync Check
tasks.prompt: What mandatory git command sequence must an agent run before reporting any bug or audit finding?
tasks.ground_truth: git fetch origin && git log -1 origin/main --oneline && git log -1 HEAD --oneline

tasks.title: Fleet Role Boundaries
tasks.prompt: Identify the primary domain responsibility of Claude Code vs Deep vs Antigravity in the fleet.
tasks.ground_truth: Claude Code=Tech Lead/Orchestration; Deep=Rust kernel & guilds; Antigravity=UI/UX & empirical verification

tasks.title: CoherenceGate Hybrid State Reason
tasks.prompt: Why was coherence_gate_hybrid_enabled set to false in tylluan.toml on 2026-08-28?
tasks.ground_truth: Was auto-starting llama-server in background without opt-in, killing active 4-day Unsloth training run

tasks.title: Autonomous Success Rate Metric Schema
tasks.prompt: What columns were added to guild_audit_log for tracking autonomous execution without human intervention?
tasks.ground_truth: latency_ms, human_intervention, risk_tier, execution_status

tasks.title: Background GPU Protection Protocol
tasks.prompt: What flag must be used when running local GGUF models during benchmark tests to protect background GPU training?
tasks.ground_truth: Must specify --n-gpu-layers 0 to run strictly on CPU

tasks.title: Live Kernel Loaded Commit Verification
tasks.prompt: How can an agent verify which git commit is currently running in the active tylluan-nexus process?
tasks.ground_truth: Query curl http://127.0.0.1:4000/health and inspect git_commit field

tasks.title: Docs-site Port and Architecture Alignment
tasks.prompt: What is the standalone architecture visualizer port and its compilation check command?
tasks.ground_truth: Runs on port 3010 (docs-site); verify with cd docs-site && pnpm run build

tasks.title: Session Mailbox Database Location

tasks.ground_truth: Stored in data/mailbox.db under coloquio_messages and coloquio_channels tables

tasks.title: Filesystem Plugin Function Names

tasks.ground_truth: file_read, file_write, file_search, file_list, find_files (read_file/write_file are legacy)

tasks.title: Python Guild Tri-Registration Invariant

tasks.ground_truth: In main.rs lazy_guilds list, router/catalog.rs catalog weight/description, and guild plugin directory

tasks.prompt: How does tylluan_do --plan execute without triggering side effects in guilds?
tasks.ground_truth: Returns proposed guild+tool+args chain without calling real guild process, reusing approve_action

tasks.title: ACL Default Role Policy

tasks.ground_truth: Applies default_role policy and denies write permissions to unprivileged readers

tasks.title: Tool Risk Tier Classification
tasks.prompt: What risk tiers exist in TOOL_METADATA for Cognitive Scheduler dispatch safety?
tasks.ground_truth: low, medium, high, critical

tasks.title: Code Graph Query Routing
tasks.prompt: Which guild analyzes call graphs and structural dependencies across crates?
tasks.ground_truth: guilds/core/code_graph.py

tasks.prompt: Describe the 4 steps to recall, verify contradiction, update node, and emit audit log in SilvaDB.
tasks.ground_truth: 1. search_hybrid recall; 2. ConsensusEngine conflict check; 3. update_node version increment; 4. insert audit trace

tasks.title: Rust Code Refactor Validation Flow
tasks.prompt: What is the mandatory 3-step compilation and quality pipeline before committing Rust changes?
tasks.ground_truth: 1. cargo check -p <crate>; 2. cargo clippy -p <crate> -- -D warnings; 3. cargo test -p <crate> --lib

tasks.title: Dynamic Guild Auto-Discovery Lifecycle
tasks.prompt: Explain how guilds/ directory is discovered at kernel startup and initialized in WarmPool.
tasks.ground_truth: Scans guilds/ at startup, validates manifest, loads always_on guilds, marks warm_pool on demand

tasks.title: Coloquio Cross-Agent Sync Pipeline
tasks.prompt: Explain how an agent reads #general, extracts @mentions, processes work item, and posts turn update.
tasks.ground_truth: Calls get_thread/search, parses @mentions with extract_mentions, performs task, posts to coloquio_messages

tasks.title: Diagnostic and Root Cause Triangulation
tasks.prompt: What sequence is used to isolate a test regression without polluting git working directory?
tasks.ground_truth: 1. git status check; 2. isolate target test; 3. execute target test; 4. inspect logs in scratch/

tasks.title: Benchmark Case Evaluation Pipeline
tasks.prompt: What are the 4 stages executed by slm_society_harness.py on benchmark datasets?
tasks.ground_truth: 1. Load cases JSON; 2. Execute Arms A/B/C inferences; 3. Compute accuracy & Jaccard; 4. Write FULL_HARNESS_REPORT.md

tasks.title: SQLite Schema Migration Flow
tasks.prompt: How does Tylluan ensure idempotent SQLite migrations on startup in SilvaDB and Mailbox?
tasks.ground_truth: Uses _migrations table with PRAGMA user_version / version hashes and ALTER TABLE IF NOT EXISTS

tasks.title: Llama Server 503 Cold Start Recovery
tasks.prompt: How should an evaluation harness poll llama-server during startup to avoid connection drops?
tasks.ground_truth: Poll http://127.0.0.1:{port}/health waiting for HTTP 200 and status ok rather than raw TCP socket connect

tasks.title: Socket Timeout Resilience in Multi-Agent Calls
tasks.prompt: How does call_server protect against socket timeouts on long synthesis prompts?
tasks.ground_truth: Sets Connection: close, expands timeout to 180s, and wraps in 3-attempt exponential backoff retry loop

tasks.title: Database WAL Recovery and msg_id Repair
tasks.prompt: What method fixes NULL or shortened msg_id values in Coloquio after an unclean system shutdown?
tasks.ground_truth: repair_msgids() in ColoquioDb assigns fresh UUIDv4 to orphaned rows

tasks.title: Sparse Engine Non-Fatal Fallback
tasks.prompt: What happens in SilvaDB initialization if the 1GB learned-sparse ONNX model fails to load?
tasks.ground_truth: Failure is non-fatal: logs warning and search_hybrid continues running with 3-source RRF fusion

tasks.title: Circuit Breaker on Remote Peer Dispatch
tasks.prompt: How does DispatchRouter handle a remote peer that times out or fails 3 consecutive requests?
tasks.ground_truth: Trips circuit breaker to Open state, falling back to local guild execution for subsequent requests

tasks.title: Anti-Collision Work Handoff Protocol
tasks.prompt: What rule prevents two agents from editing overlapping files like complexity.rs or matcher.rs simultaneously?
tasks.ground_truth: Check Coloquio active assignments; mark work in progress; do not touch files assigned to other agents

tasks.title: Single Committer Release Rule
tasks.prompt: Who is authorized to push commits to origin/main in the fleet to prevent desynchronization?
tasks.ground_truth: Only Claude Code (Tech Lead) commits and pushes to origin/main; other agents commit locally

tasks.title: Cross-Agent Schema Pre-Agreement Rule
tasks.prompt: What must two agents do before writing complementary code (e.g. backend endpoint + dashboard UI)?
tasks.ground_truth: Agree on exact field names, schemas, and ports in Coloquio before writing code

tasks.title: Independent PR and Diff Verification
tasks.prompt: What is required before announcing a milestone as closed in Coloquio?
tasks.ground_truth: Cross-agent independent verification of real diffs, test suite execution, and documentation synchronization
